messages.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer in Automotive, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

建議主軸：Current vault evidence supports one directly automotive SG opportunity—R&S SMBV100B for eCall GNSS receiver/performance testing—and treats SMW200A, SMA100B, FSW and FSVA as adjacent or unverified for automotive until more RAW automotive evidence is added [54][55].
### 推薦先賣
R&S SMBV100B for eCall GNSS receiver/performance testing is directly supported, because the eCall GNSS Testing configuration is centered on the R&S SMBV100B vector signal generator [54].
The eCall GNSS configuration lists the R&S SMBV100B base unit as mandatory and lists GNSS/eCall items including SMBVB-K44 GPS, SMBV-K66 GALILEO, SMBV-K94 GLONASS, SMBVB-K106 SBAS/QZSS, SMBVB-K108 GNSS real-world scenarios, and SMBV-K361 eCall Test Suite GNSS performance tests for eCall modules [55].
NG eCall is an automotive demand context, because Rohde & Schwarz says eCall has been mandatory for all new cars sold in the EU since 2018 and NG eCall becomes obligatory from 2026-01-01 [21].
The NG eCall verification opportunity is primarily CMX500-based rather than signal-generator/analyzer-based, because the source says the verification process used the R&S CMX500 mobile radio tester and CMX-KA098 software option [21].
Automotive radar is directly supported in the vault through the R&S AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator, whose echo generator type is dynamic artificial object generation [10][14].
AREG800A is not an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer in the current vault classification, so it should not be sold as an SMW/SMBV/SMA100B/FSW/FSVA opportunity without further evidence [47].
RAW evidence confirms SMA100B, FSW43 and FSV3044 as listed R&S test equipment, but it does not state an automotive application for them [66].
RAW evidence states EVM with an external local oscillator using the R&S SMA100B and SMA-B711 ultra low phase noise option, but it does not state an automotive application [68].

| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S SMBV100B | eCall GNSS receiver/performance testing [54] | SMBVB-B103, SMBVB-K520, SMBVB-K44, SMBV-K66, SMBV-K94, SMBVB-K137, SMBVB-K106, SMBVB-K108 and SMBV-K361 are listed in the eCall GNSS Testing configuration [55] | The configuration is centered on SMBV100B and marks the SMBV100B base unit as mandatory [54][55] | Wiki directly supports the automotive eCall GNSS use case [54][55] | RAW passages provided do not support the SMBV100B eCall GNSS automotive claim. |
| R&S SMW200A | 知識庫未證實 direct automotive opportunity | RF path A covers 100 kHz to 67 GHz and the instrument can expand from a single-path vector signal generator to a multichannel MIMO receiver tester [23] | Its MIMO and fading architecture is technically relevant to wireless receiver testing, but the provided passages do not tie SMW200A to automotive [23][26] | Wiki supports SMW200A product capability [23][26] | RAW passages provided do not mention SMW200A. |
| R&S SMA100B | 知識庫未證實 direct automotive opportunity | SMA100B covers 8 kHz to 67 GHz via SMAB-B1xx frequency options [4] | RAW states EVM with an external local oscillator using SMA100B and SMA-B711, which supports an RF performance-test angle but not an automotive claim [68] | Wiki supports SMA100B frequency coverage, and RAW supports the SMA100B EVM/external-LO use [4][68] | The passages do not tie SMA100B EVM or LO use to automotive. |
| R&S FSW | 知識庫未證實 direct automotive opportunity | FSW is a high-end signal and spectrum analyzer series covering 8 GHz to 85 GHz models, with FSW85 extendable to 90 GHz using FSW-B90G [5] | It is a high-end analyzer platform, but the provided passages do not state an automotive FSW application [5] | RAW lists R&S FSW43 as a signal and spectrum analyzer [66] | RAW lists FSW43, while the automotive link remains unsupported [66]. |
| R&S FSVA | 知識庫未證實 direct automotive opportunity | FSVA3044 is a 44 GHz signal and spectrum analyzer, and FSVA3050 can reach 54 GHz with FSV3-B54G [5] | It is an analyzer platform for RF/spectrum work, but the provided passages do not state an automotive FSVA application [5] | RAW lists R&S FSV3044 as a signal and spectrum analyzer [66] | RAW says FSV3044, while the Wiki product line shown is FSVA3044; the automotive link remains unsupported [5][66]. |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| eCall GNSS receiver/performance testing | R&S SMBV100B with the eCall GNSS configuration options listed in the CMX configuration guide [55] | Lead with the fact that the configuration is SMBV100B-centered and includes GNSS performance tests for eCall modules [54][55] | The source does not provide eCall GNSS test-suite specifications, GNSS scenario details, standard version or complete dependency tree [56]. |
| NG eCall program discussion | CMX500/CMX-KA098 as the core NG eCall platform, with SMBV100B positioned only for the separate eCall GNSS test configuration [21][55] | Use the 2026-01-01 NG eCall obligation and the CMX500 realistic-network-condition statement as the automotive demand trigger [21] | The source does not provide CMX500 configuration, CMX-KA098 version, GNSS simulation setup or pass/fail details [19]. |
| RF performance / EVM lab discussion | R&S SMA100B with SMA-B711 is supported for EVM with an external local oscillator [68] | Use this only as a generic RF-performance discussion, because RAW supports EVM with SMA100B but not automotive [68] | The provided passages do not tie this EVM use case to automotive. |
### 限制
【推論】The cleanest automotive SG entry point is SMBV100B for eCall GNSS, because eCall is an automotive regulatory context and the eCall GNSS configuration is SMBV100B-centered [21][54][55].
【推論】SMA100B can be discussed as an adjacent RF-performance tool only where the customer already has an EVM/external-LO need, because RAW supports EVM with SMA100B but not automotive [68].
【推論】FSW and FSVA should be positioned only as analyzer candidates after additional automotive test requirements are captured, because current evidence supports analyzer product facts but not automotive use cases [5][66].

NG eCall is an automotive demand context, because Rohde & Schwarz says eCall has been mandatory for all new cars sold in the EU since 2018 and NG eCall becomes obligatory from 2026-01-01 [21].
The NG eCall verification opportunity is primarily CMX500-based rather than signal-generator/analyzer-based, because the source says the verification process used the R&S CMX500 mobile radio tester and CMX-KA098 software option [21].
Automotive radar is directly supported in the vault through the R&S AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator, whose echo generator type is dynamic artificial object generation [10][14].
AREG800A is not an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer in the current vault classification, so it should not be sold as an SMW/SMBV/SMA100B/FSW/FSVA opportunity without further evidence [47].

[[R&S AREG800A]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Automotive Radar Echo Generator，用於 dynamic artificial object generation；本頁規格依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]]，文件版本 `Version 09.00`，文件日期 `September 2025（LA）`。

R&S AREG800A › 文件與適用條件
- 來源文件：[[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]]。
- 文件編號：`PD 3609.8015.22`。
- 文件版本：`Version 09.00`。
- 文件日期：`September 2025（LA）`。
- 文件名稱：`AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator`。
- Copyright：`© 2021–2025 Rohde & Schwarz`。
- 資料註記：無 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力；資料 `subject to change`。

產品資料適用條件（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- 於環境溫度儲存 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- `Specifications with limits`：以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等限制符號表示保證產品性能。
- `Non-traceable specifications with limits (n. trc.)`：依 specifications with limits 測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- `Specifications without limits`：表示保證產品性能，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等值。
- `Typical data (typ.)`、`Nominal values (nom.)`、`Measured values (meas.)` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- `Uncertainties`：coverage factor 為 2，依 GUM 計算。

R&S AREG800A › Radial velocity 與 Doppler
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- 每個 artificial object 支援 individual Doppler frequency shift：`yes`。
- Velocity setting range with [[R&S AREG8-B9]] and [[R&S AREG8-B63]]：`±500 km/h`。
- Velocity step size：
  - [[R&S AREG8-B9]] and [[R&S AREG8-B63]]：`0.001 km/h`。
  - [[R&S AREG-DBP1]] / [[R&S AREG-DBP2]] / [[R&S AREG-DBP3]] with [[R&S AREG-MFP]] / [[R&S AREG-BFP]]：`0.05 km/h`。
- Doppler frequency offset accuracy：在 IF domain 以 spectrum analyzer 量測 base unit IF input 與 IF output signal 的 frequency offset，不含 frontend，`< 1 Hz`。
- Velocity accuracy：Doppler shift velocity error 由公式 `v_error = 3.6 × (f_error/f_center) × ½ × 299 700 000 m/s` 決定；`f_center` 為 `78 GHz` 或 `79 GHz`，適用於 [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WS]] 與 [[R&S AREG8-81D]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WD]]；velocity accuracy `< 0.05 km/h`。

依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。

R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

R&S SMW200A › Wideband baseband
- `R&S®SMW-B9` arbitrary waveform mode：waveform length `1 sample to 256 Msample`；with `K515` 到 `2 Gsample`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` sample rate：`400 Hz to 600 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `400 Hz to 1200 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `400 Hz to 2400 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` RF bandwidth：`500 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `1000 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `2000 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9F` 詳細 GNSS 規格見 `GNSS simulation for Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generators specifications`，文件 `PD 3607.6896.22`。

R&S SMW200A › Digital I/Q
- Standard digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K18`；wideband digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K19`。
- Digital I/Q input/output 可用於 [[R&S SMW200A]] 與其他 Rohde & Schwarz 儀器之間的 lossless connection，例如 [[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMCV100B]] 或 CMW500 wideband radio communication tester 的 fading applications。
- DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface PAD-R`，level `LVDS`，connector `26-pin MDR`。
- HS DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R`，connector `QSFP+/QSFP 28`。
- Wideband HS DIG I/Q standard system configuration mode：40G up to `1.05 GHz`，50G up to `1.25 GHz`；advanced mode with `R&S®SMW-K822` input up to `500 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K823` input up to `1000 MHz`。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › Retrofitting summary
- Step 1 RF path A frequency options：不能 retrofitted（configuration guide）。
- Step 2 baseband main module options：可 factory retrofitted；`R&S®SMW-B13XT` retrofitting only for serial number `102700` or higher（configuration guide）。
- `R&S®SMW-B90`、`R&S®SMW-B81/-B82/-B83/-B84`：可在具 `R&S®UCS` universal calibration system 的 Rohde & Schwarz service center retrofitted（configuration guide）。
- `R&S®SMW-B10`、`R&S®SMW-B9`、`R&S®SMW-B9F`、`R&S®SMW-B14`、`R&S®SMW-B93`：可在 Rohde & Schwarz service center retrofitted；`R&S®SMW-B15` 是否可 retrofitting 取決於 instrument configuration（configuration guide）。
- 多數 software/keycode options 可由使用者透過 keycode retrofitted。

| `R&S®SMW-B13` | Signal routing and baseband main module，one I/Q path to RF section | `1413.2807.02` | Standard baseband section；not compatible with `R&S®SMW-BxxxxO` frequency options。 |
| `R&S®SMW-B13T` | Signal routing and baseband main module，two I/Q paths to RF section | `1413.3003.02` | Standard baseband section；若要安裝 RF path B 需 `B13T` 或 `B13XT`；not compatible with `R&S®SMW-BxxxxO` frequency options。 |
| `R&S®SMW-B13XT` | Wideband baseband main module，two I/Q paths to RF section | `1413.8005.02` | Wideband baseband section；RF modulation bandwidth up to `2 GHz`。 |

R&S SMW200A › 基本訂購限制
依 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]] 與 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

建議主軸：Current vault evidence supports one directly automotive SG opportunity—R&S SMBV100B for eCall GNSS receiver/performance testing—and treats SMW200A, SMA100B, FSW and FSVA as adjacent or unverified for automotive until more RAW automotive evidence is added [54][55].
### 推薦先賣
R&S SMBV100B for eCall GNSS receiver/performance testing is directly supported, because the eCall GNSS Testing configuration is centered on the R&S SMBV100B vector signal generator [54].
The eCall GNSS configuration lists the R&S SMBV100B base unit as mandatory and lists GNSS/eCall items including SMBVB-K44 GPS, SMBV-K66 GALILEO, SMBV-K94 GLONASS, SMBVB-K106 SBAS/QZSS, SMBVB-K108 GNSS real-world scenarios, and SMBV-K361 eCall Test Suite GNSS performance tests for eCall modules [55].
NG eCall is an automotive demand context, because Rohde & Schwarz says eCall has been mandatory for all new cars sold in the EU since 2018 and NG eCall becomes obligatory from 2026-01-01 [21].
The NG eCall verification opportunity is primarily CMX500-based rather than signal-generator/analyzer-based, because the source says the verification process used the R&S CMX500 mobile radio tester and CMX-KA098 software option [21].
Automotive radar is directly supported in the vault through the R&S AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator, whose echo generator type is dynamic artificial object generation [10][14].
AREG800A is not an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer in the current vault classification, so it should not be sold as an SMW/SMBV/SMA100B/FSW/FSVA opportunity without further evidence [47].
RAW evidence confirms SMA100B, FSW43 and FSV3044 as listed R&S test equipment, but it does not state an automotive application for them [66].
RAW evidence states EVM with an external local oscillator using the R&S SMA100B and SMA-B711 ultra low phase noise option, but it does not state an automotive application [68].
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S SMBV100B | eCall GNSS receiver/performance testing [54] | SMBVB-B103, SMBVB-K520, SMBVB-K44, SMBV-K66, SMBV-K94, SMBVB-K137, SMBVB-K106, SMBVB-K108 and SMBV-K361 are listed in the eCall GNSS Testing configuration [55] | The configuration is centered on SMBV100B and marks the SMBV100B base unit as mandatory [54][55] | Wiki directly supports the automotive eCall GNSS use case [54][55] | RAW passages provided do not support the SMBV100B eCall GNSS automotive claim. |
| R&S SMW200A | 知識庫未證實 direct automotive opportunity | RF path A covers 100 kHz to 67 GHz and the instrument can expand from a single-path vector signal generator to a multichannel MIMO receiver tester [23] | Its MIMO and fading architecture is technically relevant to wireless receiver testing, but the provided passages do not tie SMW200A to automotive [23][26] | Wiki supports SMW200A product capability [23][26] | RAW passages provided do not mention SMW200A. |
| R&S SMA100B | 知識庫未證實 direct automotive opportunity | SMA100B covers 8 kHz to 67 GHz via SMAB-B1xx frequency options [4] | RAW states EVM with an external local oscillator using SMA100B and SMA-B711, which supports an RF performance-test angle but not an automotive claim [68] | Wiki supports SMA100B frequency coverage, and RAW supports the SMA100B EVM/external-LO use [4][68] | The passages do not tie SMA100B EVM or LO use to automotive. |
| R&S FSW | 知識庫未證實 direct automotive opportunity | FSW is a high-end signal and spectrum analyzer series covering 8 GHz to 85 GHz models, with FSW85 extendable to 90 GHz using FSW-B90G [5] | It is a high-end analyzer platform, but the provided passages do not state an automotive FSW application [5] | RAW lists R&S FSW43 as a signal and spectrum analyzer [66] | RAW lists FSW43, while the automotive link remains unsupported [66]. |
| R&S FSVA | 知識庫未證實 direct automotive opportunity | FSVA3044 is a 44 GHz signal and spectrum analyzer, and FSVA3050 can reach 54 GHz with FSV3-B54G [5] | It is an analyzer platform for RF/spectrum work, but the provided passages do not state an automotive FSVA application [5] | RAW lists R&S FSV3044 as a signal and spectrum analyzer [66] | RAW says FSV3044, while the Wiki product line shown is FSVA3044; the automotive link remains unsupported [5][66]. |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| eCall GNSS receiver/performance testing | R&S SMBV100B with the eCall GNSS configuration options listed in the CMX configuration guide [55] | Lead with the fact that the configuration is SMBV100B-centered and includes GNSS performance tests for eCall modules [54][55] | The source does not provide eCall GNSS test-suite specifications, GNSS scenario details, standard version or complete dependency tree [56]. |
| NG eCall program discussion | CMX500/CMX-KA098 as the core NG eCall platform, with SMBV100B positioned only for the separate eCall GNSS test configuration [21][55] | Use the 2026-01-01 NG eCall obligation and the CMX500 realistic-network-condition statement as the automotive demand trigger [21] | The source does not provide CMX500 configuration, CMX-KA098 version, GNSS simulation setup or pass/fail details [19]. |
| RF performance / EVM lab discussion | R&S SMA100B with SMA-B711 is supported for EVM with an external local oscillator [68] | Use this only as a generic RF-performance discussion, because RAW supports EVM with SMA100B but not automotive [68] | The provided passages do not tie this EVM use case to automotive. |
### 限制
【推論】The cleanest automotive SG entry point is SMBV100B for eCall GNSS, because eCall is an automotive regulatory context and the eCall GNSS configuration is SMBV100B-centered [21][54][55].
【推論】SMA100B can be discussed as an adjacent RF-performance tool only where the customer already has an EVM/external-LO need, because RAW supports EVM with SMA100B but not automotive [68].
【推論】FSW and FSVA should be positioned only as analyzer candidates after additional automotive test requirements are captured, because current evidence supports analyzer product facts but not automotive use cases [5][66].

- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
